values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical): on-season (March-November) / off-season (December-February) basic $16 / $15, electric 30A $28 / $24, electric 50A $30 / $26, sewer/electric/water 30A $33 / $27, 50A $36 / $30, family electric 50A $53 / $47, platform tent $31 (closed December-February). Rates include sales tax; a family site (two pads, two electrical connections) takes one reservation fee.

note: Two campgrounds beside the State Park Marina on Table Rock Lake near Branson. Campground 2's outer loop of basic sites (271-284) sits in open woods just above the shore; Campground 1's sites are set back behind the paved lakeshore trail. Boat and ATV trailers may park off the pad on the grass; park gates close at 10 p.m. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15-16 basic base, electric +12 / full hookup +20 (2027 = 2026); added military $2, 50A with water+sewer, 150 sites to 74 ft with a pull-through, showers/flush/dump/laundry/water, 12-month window, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30, reservations year-round. Lakefront kept on Campground 2's south-shore basic sites (imagery); Campground 1 is behind the lakeshore trail. Not a split (300-560 m apart). Note corrected (the shore sites are basic, not full-hookup).
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront kept, on Campground 2 only: on leaf-off, low-water Esri imagery with the UseDirect site points, Campground 2's outer loop of basic sites 271, 272, 274, 276, 278, 280, 282-284 sits ~17-35 m from the wooded shore edge (~20-47 m to the water at the imaged low level) through open-understory woods, with the campground's loop road on the inland side and no trail, drive or day-use between (270/271 border the marina's boat-trailer lot to the west). Campground 1 is lakeview at best: its southern sites 107-115 are ~40-60 m from the cove with the paved Table Rock Lakeshore Trail (day use) running between them and the shore, and 150-185 sit ~60-90 m back above the west arm through woods. The stored note's 'full-hookup RV sites wind along the shoreline' is wrong: the shore sites are basic.
